_meta.description: Indicative cost and journey-time characteristics per transport mode, used by the weighted eco-scoring function so that emissions can be traded off against the two things travellers actually feel: money and hours.
_meta.cost_basis: Typical 2026 advance-purchase European fares per passenger-kilometre, EUR.
_meta.time_basis: avg_speed_kmh is door-to-door average including intermediate stops. access_overhead_h is the fixed time cost that does not scale with distance (security, check-in, transfers, boarding).
_meta.caveat: These are planning heuristics, not quotes. Live fares should come from the Amadeus integration where a key is configured.

overnight_credit.comment: A sleeper train replaces a night of accommodation, which is a real saving in both money and emissions. The credit is capped at max_fare_reduction_share of the fare so a sleeper can never appear free, which would distort the cost ranking.
